annotations.title: Request a human to be present on site in a time window

description: Request that a human waits on site during a time window (delivery, technician, handover) and confirms what happened. Requires authorisation of the premises holder. Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Pilot price: EUR 29 for the first hour on site, then EUR 20 per hour (+ EUR 0.50/km outside the pilot region).

authorization.description: Who is entitled to the premises and has authorised us.

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.
